text: في الدقيقة 65، قررت Seabrook Town تشديد الضغط على الخصم واللعب بشكل أكثر مباشرة لمحاولة تعويض النتيجة بعد تأخرها 2-1. رغم زيادة فرص التسجيل المتوقعة من 0.45 إلى 0.61 – يعني أن فرص التسجيل زادت بشكل ملحوظ – إلا أن سيطرة الفريق على الملعب انخفضت، مما يعكس قوة دفاع Harbour City الذي حافظ على تحت السيطرة رغم الضغط العالي [#1361]. فريق Seabrook Town يلعب بحماسة أكبر الآن لكنه يحتاج لتحويل هذه الفرص إلى أهداف.

- Seabrook Town increased their press intensity from 0.66 to 0.84 and directness from 0.42 to 0.57 at 65' to chase the game [#1361].  
- After the tactical change, Seabrook Town's xG improved from 0.45 to 0.61 in the following 15 minutes [#1361].  
- Seabrook Town's field tilt dropped from 71.4% before the change to 47.8% after the change [#1361].  
- Possession percentage for Seabrook Town rose slightly from 53.6% before to 54.4% after the substitution [#1361].  
- Seabrook Town had fewer high turnovers after the change, decreasing from 4 to 3 [#1361].

- Seabrook Town shifted tactics at 65' by increasing their pressing intensity, playing more direct passes, and raising their defensive line height, aiming to chase the game after being 2-1 down [#1361].
- This tactical change reflects Seabrook Town's 3-4-3 formation and their style of wide, crossing play; pressing higher and more direct play helps quickly regain possession to exploit wide areas for crosses.
- Despite the intensified pressing (press up from 0.66 to 0.84) and more direct attacks (directness up from 0.42 to 0.57), their field tilt dropped significantly (from 71.4% to 47.8%), suggesting Harbour City's 4-2-3-1 formation and patient short passing style effectively resisted the pressure, controlling the midfield to limit Seabrook’s influence.
- Seabrook’s adjustments led to a slight increase in expected goals (xG from 0.45 to 0.61) and maintained similar possession (around 54%), indicating that the higher press and directness created more attacking opportunities but did not translate into goals immediately [#1361].
